test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, E, G, P, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only three people sit between P and E when counted from the left of P. Only three people sit between M and A when counted from the right of A. L sits to the immediate right of M. G is an immediate neighbour of A as well as E. Who sits to the second to the left of B?
solution:
Given: A, B, E, G, P, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only three people sit between P and E when counted from the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c48d1383ce8b6ce5b52719eccd8e3e9aeeefdba5fe1d8ab9c20077a7df939f6c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2affcc0726ce89e02acdaa313ad15b2efeaa86415fb5aee7a27cd402ea027056.png] 

2) G is an immediate neighbour of A as well as E. 

3) Only three people sit between M and A when counted from the right of A.

As position of G with respect to E is not known yet therefore there are two possible positions.

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6772f6ab03393093513e2eabe476f147ff3ee9f54e35583f939c8068e029de5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5dc8f19b4ab3a24e14e61e3df787e5e233c5b4ac90bb06974117474c40b0482.png] 

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/860734fdac2e528cab14d922c36c98e9debf3703d5172eeae6b37289dfb3e6cf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f67b5d7cf2361655f17d56cf81efd6d5d7bb01128f531a408b5c0a18ee3a2294.png] 

4) L sits to the immediate right of M.

As there is no possible for L in case 1, therefore case 1 is eliminated.

After positioning L only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e13df6ece8391d9f7acc066833ec73c902bf514c116ed8625d36039f84c2017.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c9dd6d56f807f655515c3a4eb7452f6bfe293be9c2bf44de0e058c18afbcbc8.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, G sits to the second to the left of B.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
